_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/combat/test_combat_damage_by_toughness.py. t_cdt_formation is Assault Formation's and Felothar's first line alone; t_cdt_herdmaster is Baldin's ('during your turn, each creature ...'); t_cdt_brace is Walking Bulwark's damage clause as a timed op on a target; t_cdt_tower is a 1/5 trampler, so power and toughness differ in both directions the tests read.

cards.name: Test Toughness Formation
cards.oracle_text: Each creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.

abilities.text: Each creature you control assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.

cards.name: Test Toughness Herdmaster
cards.oracle_text: During your turn, each creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.

abilities.text: During your turn, each creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.

cards.name: Test Toughness Brace

abilities.text: {T}: Until end of turn, target creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
